name: Anglia Ruskin University
aLevelReq: AAA, including Chemistry or Biology plus one of Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics or Psychology, plus a third subject.
gcseReq: Minimum grade 5 in English Language, Mathematics and two sciences.
ucatPolicy: UCAT ranking; no guaranteed fixed cutoff
ucatDetail: UCAT required. Academically eligible applicants are ranked by UCAT for interview. WAMS applicants receive a 5% UCAT uplift; some specified widening-access groups can receive a guaranteed interview if other conditions are met.
contextualDetail: WAMS can reduce the offer to ABB and adds a 5% UCAT uplift. Specific groups such as recent free-school-meal recipients, qualifying care-experienced applicants and named outreach-programme completers may qualify for guaranteed interview subject to academic/SJT conditions.
teachingModel: Integrated, systems-based MBChB with early patient contact, clinical skills, anatomy teaching and progressively larger placement blocks.
studentLife: A smaller, modern campus-city experience. Chelmsford is a commuter-oriented Essex city with quick rail access to London; students who want a compact cohort may like it, while those wanting a huge nightlife/student-quarter environment may prefer larger cities.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere.

name: Aston University
aLevelReq: A*AA including Chemistry and Biology, with the A* in Chemistry or Biology.
gcseReq: At least six GCSEs at grade 6 or above including English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry and Biology/Double Science. Aston notes that many interviewed applicants have substantially stronger GCSE profiles.
ucatDetail: UCAT total score is used in ranking for interview and can also contribute to offer decisions after interview.
contextualDetail: Eligible applicants may receive a reduced offer around AAB and favourable contextual consideration. Exact criteria include combinations of educational disadvantage, postcode/school factors, care/FSM and recognised widening-participation activity.
teachingModel: Five-year patient-centred curriculum in two phases. It uses PBL/CBL, lectures, practical work, clinical skills and clinical apprenticeships.
studentLife: Aston sits very close to central Birmingham. That gives access to a large, diverse city, major hospitals, cheaper living than London and a broad student population across several Birmingham universities.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: Bangor University – North Wales Medical School
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology plus one of Chemistry, Physics, Economics, Mathematics, Further Mathematics or Statistics (check exact approved combinations on current page).
gcseReq: English/Welsh, Mathematics and science requirements apply; grade 6-level performance is commonly specified in the core subjects.
ucatDetail: UCAT required. No permanent fixed 2027 total cutoff is published; selection uses the current applicant cohort rather than promising one score that always guarantees interview.
contextualDetail: Contextual applicants can receive a reduced offer around AAB, with Welsh/UK deprivation, educational context and individual disadvantage relevant to eligibility.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated curriculum with a strong North Wales, community and rural-health identity. Case-based and community-based learning feature prominently.
studentLife: Bangor is compact, coastal and close to Snowdonia/Eryri. It strongly suits students who value outdoors access and smaller-community living; it is much less suitable for someone whose priority is a large-city nightlife and dense urban hospital network.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: Brighton and Sussex Medical School
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology and Chemistry.
gcseReq: Mathematics and English at grade 6.
ucatPolicy: UCAT ranking; no guaranteed fixed cutoff
ucatDetail: After academic screening, applicants with acceptable SJT are ranked by total cognitive UCAT score out of 2700. Interview places are filled down that ranking; UCAT may also be a final discriminator after interview.
contextualDetail: Home applicants meeting the required combination of contextual criteria are considered in a separate pool; BSMS aims to reserve about 30% of interviews for contextual applicants. Care-experienced applicants can receive particularly strong protection. Reduced offers may apply.
teachingModel: Integrated five-year curriculum with strong anatomy, early clinical contact and a gradual shift from campus science/clinical skills into long ward-based rotations.
studentLife: Brighton is one of the UK's most distinctive student cities: seaside, liberal, arts/music-heavy and compact enough to feel social. Housing and general living costs are materially higher than many northern medical-school cities.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere.

name: Brunel University of London
aLevelReq: AAA–AAB including A in Biology or Chemistry, A in a second science (Biology/Chemistry/Physics/Maths) and A/B in a third subject.
gcseReq: Core GCSE requirements apply, generally around grade 6 in key subjects; check the live Brunel table for your qualification pattern.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT required for school-leaver entry. Brunel considers qualifications/admissions information rather than publishing a simple 'top UCAT only' rule.
contextualDetail: May include a reduced offer and/or favourable treatment in shortlisting; check the detailed contextual tab.
teachingModel: Modern integrated curriculum with a strong Team-Based Learning (TBL) identity, structured self-directed preparation, clinical skills and placements from early in the course.
studentLife: Brunel has a true campus in Uxbridge rather than a central-London footprint. That can mean stronger campus community and somewhat lower housing pressure than Zone 1, while still providing access to London; it is not the same lifestyle as King's/UCL/Imperial.
strategicNote: There is no single metric that guarantees an interview. The school combines several elements, so applicants should assess the whole profile rather than chase one cutoff.

name: Cardiff University
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology or Chemistry plus a second science from Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics or Psychology.
gcseReq: Cardiff uses a relatively strong GCSE academic profile; English, Maths and sciences must meet minimums and GCSE achievement has historically mattered in shortlisting.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT required. Cardiff does not offer a single forever-safe cutoff; test performance is incorporated into its admissions scoring/selection alongside academics.
contextualDetail: Context can influence how academic attainment is interpreted and progression through selection; route-specific reduced offers/outreach schemes also exist.
teachingModel: C21 integrated spiral curriculum in three phases. Years 1–2 use case-centred/team-based learning; Years 3–4 are extended clinical placement years; Year 5 is preparation for practice within clinical teams.
studentLife: Cardiff has a very strong student-city identity, major sports/music venues, a compact centre and relatively affordable living for a UK capital. The medical school sits within a large teaching-hospital environment rather than feeling isolated from healthcare.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: City St George's, University of London
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry and Biology/Human Biology.
gcseReq: Five GCSEs at grade 6 or above including English Language, Mathematics and science requirements.
ucatDetail: Minimum 500 in each cognitive UCAT section. An overall total cutoff is calculated annually, so there is no permanent guaranteed total score.
contextualDetail: Contextual applicants can receive reduced offers (up to around two grades depending on route) and additional consideration. Exact benefit depends on the contextual group.
teachingModel: Hospital-centred integrated curriculum combining clinical sciences, professional/patient-population themes, practical skills, small-group/case learning and increasing clinical immersion.
studentLife: Tooting is lively, multicultural and well connected but not central-West-End London. Students get a strong healthcare community and South London lifestyle, with the trade-off of London prices.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee.

name: Edge Hill University
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology and Chemistry plus one other subject.
gcseReq: At least five GCSEs around grade 6 or above including core English, Maths and science requirements.
ucatDetail: UCAT required. After academic screening, applicants are ranked against the cohort for interview; no permanent fixed 'safe' score should be assumed.
contextualDetail: Contextual/foundation eligibility can materially lower academic entry requirements on the designated route; standard A100 benefits should be checked against the current scheme rather than assumed.
teachingModel: Integrated five-year programme built around person/community, systems science and steadily increasing patient-facing clinical experience.
studentLife: A campus-led experience with Liverpool accessible by train. It suits students who want a quieter home base but still want a large city within reach.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere.

name: Hull York Medical School
aLevelReq: AAA-equivalent standard with Chemistry and Biology requirements; check the current detailed subject table. Graduate applicants have separate BBB/degree rules.
gcseReq: GCSE English Language and Maths at grade 6/B or above are minimums; GCSE achievement is also part of the interview-selection scoring for school-leaver applicants.
ucatDetail: UCAT is scored by decile/section policy and combined with GCSE/academic points; SJT contributes separately. There is no single fixed raw cutoff that describes the whole process.
contextualDetail: Eligible applicants receive contextual points in shortlisting and may receive a reduced A-level offer around ABB. Because context enters the scoring before interview, it can change whether someone is invited, not just the grades required after an offer.
teachingModel: Integrated curriculum built strongly around Problem-Based Learning, early and sustained clinical exposure, clinical/communication skills, anatomy, workshops, lectures and scholarship.
studentLife: Hull and York offer very different lifestyles: York is historic/touristy and can be more expensive; Hull is larger, cheaper and has a different nightlife/city feel. Allocation therefore meaningfully shapes first-year experience.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee. HYMS explicitly scores GCSE profile, UCAT decile and SJT, then adds contextual points where applicable.

name: Imperial College London
aLevelReq: Minimum AAA including Biology and Chemistry plus a third subject; the standard offer is likely A*AA with the A* in Biology or Chemistry (contextual A* may be in any subject).
gcseReq: Relatively light formal GCSE burden compared with many schools; English Language requirement is important, but there is not a large GCSE-points shortlisting system.
ucatDetail: UCAT is used to shortlist eligible applicants to interview. The threshold is cohort-dependent; no one historic score should be presented as a permanent guarantee.
contextualDetail: Eligible applicants who meet academic minimums and Imperial's contextual admissions-test threshold can receive a guaranteed interview. Context can also alter the standard offer conditions.
teachingModel: Six-year integrated, case-based and research-intensive curriculum. Science and clinical practice are deliberately connected; Year 4 is an intercalated BSc/research year.
studentLife: South Kensington/West London offers exceptional cultural and academic access, but housing is expensive and the campus population is STEM-heavy. Medicine students also spend significant time away from the main campus at hospitals.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere.

name: Keele University
aLevelReq: A*AA for standard school-leaver entry, including Biology or Chemistry plus another approved science/quantitative subject and a third academic subject.
gcseReq: Strong GCSE profile expected; core English Language, Maths and sciences require at least grade 6/B, with the school historically expecting several high GCSE grades for school leavers.
ucatDetail: Home applicants: published minimum total 1700 with SJT no worse than Band 3. UCAT grade is combined with the scored personal statement to rank for interview. International applicants have a higher published minimum (1950) and are then ranked by UCAT.
contextualDetail: Context can support selection and reduced offers/pathways; exact benefit depends on the applicant's scheme. Keele's process should be checked carefully because personal-statement evidence remains unusually important.
teachingModel: Integrated spiral curriculum with substantial anatomy, systems science, clinical skills and immersive placement years.
studentLife: Keele is a large parkland campus outside Stoke. It offers a strong self-contained student community but less spontaneous city-centre life; students use Newcastle-under-Lyme/Stoke for wider amenities.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee.

name: Kent and Medway Medical School
aLevelReq: AAA/AAB including Biology or Chemistry, another science, and a third subject studied concurrently.
gcseReq: Normally at least five GCSEs around grade 6 including core subjects; exact shortlisting treatment depends on applicant group.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT required. KMMS combines UCAT with a distinctive contextualised-academic process rather than publishing a single raw cutoff that guarantees interview.
contextualDetail: Academic attainment is contextualised against school performance for relevant applicants; this can change interview competitiveness. Additional widening-participation criteria may also affect offer/selection treatment.
teachingModel: Newer integrated course with strong Team-Based Learning, case-based clinical application, anatomy/clinical skills and early community exposure.
studentLife: Canterbury is historic, compact and student-heavy, with easy access to London but a much smaller-city feel. The wider Kent/Medway clinical footprint exposes students to both urban and rural/community medicine.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: King's College London
aLevelReq: A*AA overall is the typical standard, with grade A required in both Biology and Chemistry.
gcseReq: English Language and Mathematics typically require grade 6; GCSE profile can contribute to holistic shortlisting.
ucatDetail: UCAT, SJT, GCSEs and predicted/achieved academic performance are considered together. There is no guaranteed single UCAT score for interview.
contextualDetail: Standard A100 contextual treatment can affect assessment, while the dedicated EMDP offers a structurally different widening-access route with lower academic requirements for eligible UK applicants.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated curriculum combining biomedical science, clinical practice, anatomy, case-based/small-group learning and very extensive London placements.
studentLife: KCL offers a very urban, distributed London experience rather than one enclosed campus. Medicine can span Guy's, Denmark Hill and other clinical sites, giving variety but also travel.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: Lancaster University
aLevelReq: AAA including two of Biology, Chemistry and Psychology; alternatively AAB in three A levels plus EPQ/4th AS/4th A level at grade B, subject to detailed rules.
gcseReq: Core GCSE English/Maths/science requirements apply; verify exact grades on current admissions page.
ucatDetail: After academic eligibility, applicants are ranked using UCAT for interview. No permanent 'safe' threshold is promised because it depends on the cohort.
contextualDetail: Eligible contextual applicants may receive around ABB and can be treated differently around UCAT thresholds/selection. Lancaster also operates a dedicated Gateway Year route for eligible widening-participation students.
teachingModel: PBL-centred five-year integrated programme with systems science, clinical skills, early patient contact and a rapid transition to extensive placements.
studentLife: A classic campus university just outside a compact historic city, with exceptional access to the Lake District. It suits students who value community/outdoors more than metropolitan nightlife.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere.

name: Newcastle University
aLevelReq: AAA; unusually, no compulsory A-level subject is required for standard entry, though science practical rules apply when sciences are taken.
gcseReq: No simple high GCSE minimum points system, but academic attainment/GCSE information contributes to the current academic screen.
ucatDetail: UCAT points are combined with academic points to create an 'academic screen' score for interview ranking. SJT Band 4 is rejected.
contextualDetail: Contextual offer can be up to two grades lower (published example ABB with specified science combination). PARTNERS can reduce the effective offer further, up to three grades below typical requirements, if successfully completed.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated, case-led medical course with early clinical experience and extensive North-East placement years.
studentLife: Newcastle is compact for a large city, with major nightlife, sports/culture and comparatively affordable housing. The medical school has access to major tertiary hospitals but students should accept North-East regional placement travel.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: Queen Mary University of London (Barts and The London)
aLevelReq: A*AA standard offer; Chemistry/Biology/science combinations required under the current detailed admissions table.
gcseReq: Core English, Maths and science requirements apply; academic tariff/attainment remains important rather than GCSEs being a simple pass/fail formality.
ucatDetail: UCAT required. Applicants below the fourth national decile are not considered further; being above it does not guarantee interview. Shortlisting uses a weighted score that can include UCAT plus UCAS tariff/academic attainment.
contextualDetail: A standard contextual offer around AAA is available to eligible applicants; some access/care routes can reduce requirements further and/or provide guaranteed-interview benefits.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated MBBS combining Problem-Based Learning and Team-Based Learning with systems science, anatomy, clinical skills and early patient experience.
studentLife: The medical school is strongly rooted in East London rather than a generic central-London campus. That gives an intense urban healthcare experience and a distinctive Barts identity within Queen Mary.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: Queen's University Belfast
aLevelReq: Typically AAA plus fourth-AS/A*AA variants depending on qualification pattern; Chemistry and another science are required under detailed rules.
gcseReq: GCSE attainment is important and is explicitly scored in the traditional QUB shortlisting system, so a strong high-grade GCSE profile is valuable.
ucatDetail: UCAT is added to academic/GCSE points for interview shortlisting; not a pure total-score cutoff school.
contextualDetail: Individual educational/disadvantage circumstances and specific access routes can be considered. Applicants should check domicile-specific and programme-specific criteria rather than assuming a blanket lower offer.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated, case-based curriculum with clinical skills from Year 1, cadaveric dissection (specimens permitting), progress testing and increasing primary/secondary-care placements.
studentLife: A genuine city-campus experience with lower living costs than London and strong cultural/nightlife options. Medicine students can encounter both major Belfast hospitals and more distributed Northern Ireland services.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee.

name: St Mary's University Twickenham
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry or Biology and another science (Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Maths); a third subject may be outside science.
gcseReq: Current Level 2/GCSE requirements apply; international applicants should check the equivalency table.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: Admissions test requirements should be checked on the live 2027 page; this new route should not be assigned a historical cutoff from another school.
selectionModel: New programme — verify live admissions process
contextualDetail: N/A for Home contextual applicants in the 2027 standard-entry cycle.
teachingModel: New five-year medical programme; teaching is expected to combine integrated sciences, clinical skills and London clinical placements, but long-term outcome/student evidence is not yet available.
studentLife: St Mary's has a smaller, greener Twickenham campus in South-West London, offering a campus atmosphere that differs from central-London medical schools.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee.

name: University College London (UCL)
aLevelReq: A*AA including Biology and Chemistry, with the A* in either Biology or Chemistry.
gcseReq: English Language and Mathematics at grade 6; UCL does not use a large GCSE-points ranking system like Birmingham/Oxford.
ucatPolicy: UCAT ranking; no guaranteed fixed cutoff
ucatDetail: Total UCAT score is used to rank eligible applicants for interview. SJT can be used as a tie-break/secondary measure.
contextualDetail: Eligible Home applicants can receive a reduced Medicine offer around AAB with the required Biology/Chemistry conditions. Contextual factors include school performance, postcode disadvantage, care experience and estrangement.
teachingModel: Six-year systems-based integrated course with early clinical exposure and a compulsory iBSc. The curriculum is transitioning for the 2027 cohort, so some details will be newly implemented.
studentLife: Bloomsbury/central London places students in a large, mixed-discipline university community with enormous society/research access. Clinical placements spread beyond the central campus.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere.

name: University of Aberdeen
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry and one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics, plus another subject.
gcseReq: English and Maths grade 6-equivalent requirements apply; science preparation is also checked.
ucatDetail: UCAT is combined with academic assessment. Scottish contextual applicants meeting minimum academics can be guaranteed interview if their UCAT is within the top 75% of Aberdeen applicants. SIMD20/care-experienced applicants receive a 10% UCAT uplift; SIMD40 applicants receive 5%.
selectionModel: Academics + UCAT, with strong contextual adjustment
contextualDetail: Adjusted offer AAB. Scottish-domiciled applicants meeting minimum academics and a UCAT in the top 75% of Aberdeen applicants can be guaranteed interview. 10% UCAT uplift for SIMD20/care-experienced school leavers and 5% for SIMD40.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated medical course centred heavily on the Foresterhill health campus, with systems-based science, early clinical skills and later urban/rural placements.
studentLife: Aberdeen offers a compact city, lower costs than London and very direct hospital-campus integration. It especially suits students interested in rural/remote medicine and Scotland's northern health system.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Birmingham
aLevelReq: A*AA including Biology/Human Biology and Chemistry.
gcseReq: GCSEs are materially scored/considered. Applicants need strong core grades and competitive school-level attainment; Birmingham is not merely a minimum-GCSE school.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT contributes to pre-interview selection alongside academic/GCSE scoring. International applicants can face more UCAT-heavy ranking.
contextualDetail: Eligible Home applicants may receive reduced offers around AAB and/or altered shortlisting treatment. Free-school-meal, care and partner-programme status can be particularly significant.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated programme. A new curriculum launched in 2026, organised around one integrated medicine module per year rather than the older module map.
studentLife: Birmingham provides a major-city experience with a huge student population and substantial cultural diversity. The medical school is close to one of the UK's largest teaching hospitals.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Bristol
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
gcseReq: Current formal GCSE requirements are comparatively limited, but exact English/Maths criteria should be checked on the live page.
ucatDetail: One of the most UCAT-dominant schools: once academic minimums are met, UCAT ranking is the key interview selector. Any prior-cycle cutoff must be labelled historical, not treated as a 2027 guarantee.
contextualDetail: Contextual offer can be up to two grades lower: published 2027 A-level contextual offer ABB with A in Chemistry and B in the second required science. Eligibility includes aspiring state schools, low HE progression, Bristol outreach, care and FSM.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated programme, research-informed and clinically oriented, with early patient contact and increasing placement immersion across Bristol/South-West services.
studentLife: Large, vibrant, hilly city with a very strong student identity and broad cultural scene. It is less campus-contained than universities like Keele/Lancaster.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere. Bristol is one of the clearest examples where, after academic eligibility, UCAT ranking becomes decisive for interview selection.

name: University of Buckingham
aLevelReq: ABB including Chemistry or Biology.
gcseReq: English/Maths requirements apply; academic entry profile is less restrictive than many public A100 schools.
ucatDetail: No UCAT requirement. Buckingham uses its own selection/assessment process including interview/MMI-style assessment.
contextualDetail: No standard contextual-offer system comparable with Bristol/Manchester/Sheffield.
teachingModel: Accelerated 4.5-year January-start MBChB. Phase 1 integrates body systems and clinical context; Phase 2 moves into intensive hospital/community clinical training.
studentLife: Buckingham is a small town, not a large student city. The medical experience is heavily shaped by the course cohort and regional placements rather than a huge campus social ecosystem.
strategicNote: UCAT is not the strategic lever here. Focus on the school's own academic screen, assessment/interview process and eligibility/fee model. Buckingham is a private medical school with its own admissions process and no UCAT; cost and January-start structure are major strategic considerations.

name: University of Cambridge
aLevelReq: A*A*A including Chemistry and at least one of Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics or Physics (college-specific expectations can be stricter).
gcseReq: No formal GCSE minimum, but academic context and overall record matter. College requirements and subject preparation should be checked individually.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT is used within holistic shortlisting/interview selection. Cambridge does not publish a single guaranteed cutoff. SJT is not used for 2027 under current policy.
contextualDetail: School, postcode, care and other contextual information can influence how an application is interpreted/interviewed. Applicants should not assume a reduced Medicine offer unless a specific Cambridge scheme says so.
teachingModel: Classic six-year science-heavy course: Years 1–2 preclinical medical sciences with intensive practical/supervision teaching; Year 3 specialist study/BA; Years 4–6 clinical.
studentLife: A compact collegiate city where college identity strongly shapes social life, accommodation and support. It is academically intense and expensive, but unusually walkable/cyclable.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Dundee
aLevelReq: AAA including either Chemistry or Biology plus another science (Mathematics accepted); if one of Bio/Chem is not at A level, GCSE 7 is required, with Maths/English grade 6 if not at A level.
gcseReq: Conditional on A-level subjects; Biology or Chemistry at grade 7 if missing at A level, and Maths/English around grade 6 where not superseded.
ucatDetail: UCAT required; academics and test performance are considered together. No stable fixed 2027 total cutoff should be assumed.
contextualDetail: A contextual offer around ABB is available for eligible applicants, with Scottish widening-participation data/programmes particularly relevant.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated spiral course centred physically around Ninewells Hospital. Systems science, clinical skills and patient contact start early.
studentLife: Compact and relatively affordable, with the medical school/hospital physically integrated at Ninewells. The city has a strong student population and easy access to wider Scotland.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of East Anglia (Norwich Medical School)
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology or Chemistry.
gcseReq: At least six GCSEs at grade 7/A including Mathematics and either two sciences or Double Science under the currently displayed MSC record; English requirement also applies.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 total cutoff has been published in the MSC record currently available. NOTE: MSC is still showing a September 2026 start for this course, so all UEA 2027 figures must be re-verified before production use.
contextualDetail: Benefits vary by route; dedicated gateway provision is especially important. Standard A100 2027 contextual details need re-verification when the updated record is published.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated, PBL/case-heavy programme with very early clinical exposure, regular GP learning and later hospital blocks across East Anglia.
studentLife: UEA has a true campus just outside Norwich, with lake/green space and a strong student-community feel. Norwich is smaller and calmer than Manchester/Birmingham but has a substantial cultural/student scene.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee.

name: University of Edinburgh
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry and one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics under current school-leaver requirements; exact qualification combinations vary by domicile.
gcseReq: Strong science/core academic requirements; GCSE-level Biology, Chemistry, English and Maths at high grades are expected for relevant applicants.
ucatDetail: UCAT is explicitly scored within a multi-component selection model rather than being the only screen. Academic performance accounts for 25% of the overall application score; UCAT and SJT are separately scored before the Assessment Day/interview component. Use the current admissions booklet for the exact 2027 minimum/weighting.
selectionModel: Weighted academics + UCAT + SJT + assessment day
contextualDetail: Context is based on home postcode, school/college, care/refugee/asylum status and recognised access programmes. Plus Flag applicants can receive significantly reduced academic requirements (often around AAB-equivalent depending on qualification) and separate consideration.
teachingModel: Six-year integrated programme combining biomedical science, clinical/professional learning, evidence/research and a compulsory research/intercalated element.
studentLife: One of the UK's most attractive student cities, with a huge festival/cultural scene and dense historic centre. Housing pressure and cost are significant practical negatives.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Exeter
aLevelReq: A*AA including grade A in Biology and Chemistry.
gcseReq: English Language grade 6 is the principal published GCSE minimum on the MSC 2027 page; check any qualification-specific additions.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT is used to select school-leaver applicants; the competitive threshold is cohort-dependent rather than fixed forever.
contextualDetail: Depending on postcode, school, FSM, care and recognised outreach, eligible applicants can receive materially reduced academic offers. Exeter's contextual matrix should be checked because different indicators can produce different reductions.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated BMBS with early patient exposure and a strong distributed Devon/Cornwall clinical model.
studentLife: Compact university city with a strong campus identity and excellent access to Devon/Cornwall outdoors. Social life is student-heavy but less metropolitan.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Glasgow
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry and Biology/Physics/Mathematics under current subject rules.
gcseReq: English and science/core requirements apply; Biology may be required at GCSE if not offered at A level.
ucatDetail: Staged process: applicants meet academic eligibility and then a UCAT threshold/ranking stage before interview. Thresholds vary by cycle and applicant domicile; do not use one historical total as a 2027 guarantee.
contextualDetail: Adjusted academic requirements and widening-access routes are available for eligible Scottish applicants; applicants from the rest of the UK should check the exact current scheme rather than assuming the same benefits.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated spiral course using PBL/CBL, lectures, anatomy/dissection/prosection, practicals and progressively intensive clinical placements.
studentLife: Large, affordable-by-big-city-standards urban university experience with major music/nightlife/cultural options and a huge NHS network.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Greater Manchester
aLevelReq: AAB including Chemistry or Biology plus one of Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics, with a third subject in any accepted area.
gcseReq: Five GCSEs around grade 6 including English, Mathematics and sciences under current entry information.
ucatDetail: Current public information indicates no UCAT requirement for this new route; verify immediately before application because the course is new.
contextualDetail: N/A for Home applicants.
teachingModel: New five-year curriculum; detailed mature year-by-year student evidence is not yet available.
studentLife: Bolton offers cheaper living than central Manchester with access to the wider Greater Manchester region, but it is not the same central-city campus experience as the University of Manchester.
strategicNote: UCAT is not the strategic lever here. Focus on the school's own academic screen, assessment/interview process and eligibility/fee model.

name: University of Hertfordshire
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry and Biology/Human Biology, completed in one sitting across a maximum of two years.
gcseReq: Five GCSEs at grade 6 or above including English, Mathematics and sciences under current published criteria.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT used to rank eligible applicants. No mature historical cutoff should be presented because the first cohort begins in 2026.
selectionModel: UCAT ranking after academic screen (new programme)
contextualDetail: N/A for Home applicants.
teachingModel: New integrated five-year MBBS with case-based clinical science, professional skills, patient/population/society themes and clinical placements from Year 1.
studentLife: Hatfield is a campus/suburban experience with easy London access but much less city-centre atmosphere than London medical schools.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Lancashire
aLevelReq: AAA in one sitting, with at least two sciences including Chemistry.
gcseReq: Core GCSE requirements apply; check exact current levels for Home/international status.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT required; current public information does not publish a stable 2027 cutoff. Treat the threshold as dynamic.
contextualDetail: Reduced offers and/or additional consideration may apply to eligible applicants; dedicated foundation/access routes are also relevant.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated MBBS with early patient contact, systems science and North-West clinical placements.
studentLife: Preston is a medium-sized, relatively affordable city with rail access across the North-West; less metropolitan than Manchester/Liverpool but cheaper.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee.

name: University of Leeds
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry and Biology. A fourth A level gives no advantage, and A* is not scored above A for the relevant academic scoring purpose.
gcseReq: At least six GCSEs at grade 5+ including Maths, English Language, Biology and Chemistry/Double Science; the broader academic history is considered during shortlisting.
ucatDetail: UCAT is considered with GCSE/academic history; not a simple raw-score-only ranking school.
contextualDetail: Access to Leeds can reduce the Medicine offer to around ABB for eligible applicants. Eligibility uses combinations of low income/FSM, first-generation HE, school performance, disruption, postcode and care experience.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated curriculum combining biomedical science, early clinical competence, clinical reasoning, ethics/patient safety, research and later immersive placements.
studentLife: One of the UK's biggest student cities, with dense nightlife/culture and extensive hospital infrastructure. Generally cheaper than London/Bristol.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Leicester
aLevelReq: A*AA including Chemistry or Biology plus another approved science, with the A* in an accepted science; AAA plus EPQ/AS/Welsh qualification at B can also be considered under published alternatives.
gcseReq: Core Maths, English Language and Chemistry/Biology around grade 6 for relevant applicants; academic scoring rules are published and should be used rather than vague GCSE claims.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT and academic qualifications are weighted 50:50 pre-interview. SJT Band 4 is not considered.
contextualDetail: Eligible applicants can receive reduced offers around AAA on A100, while the A199 foundation route has lower requirements for those meeting specific widening-participation criteria.
teachingModel: Five-year course with a clearer preclinical-to-clinical progression than PBL-heavy schools, but still integrating clinical context, patient contact and case learning.
studentLife: Diverse, compact Midlands city with good rail links and relatively affordable living. Medical students benefit from large local hospitals without London's cost.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile. Leicester is unusually transparent about roughly 50:50 academic and UCAT weighting before interview.

name: University of Lincoln
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology.
gcseReq: At least six GCSEs at grade 7 or above including Biology and Chemistry/Double Science, with at least grade 6 in English Language and Mathematics.
ucatDetail: UCAT required. Individual UCAT sections and SJT are converted to points and added to GCSE points to create an Academic Score. No fixed raw UCAT cutoff is published; SJT Band 4 is rejected.
contextualDetail: Eligible applicants can receive up to a 20% uplift to the total pre-interview score and an AAB contextual offer (with A in Biology). Criteria include postcode/school disadvantage, FSM, care, refugee status and other contextual markers.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated course with case-based learning, clinical/professional skills and a new purpose-built medical-school environment.
studentLife: Historic, compact city with the university on Brayford Pool. Most daily student life is walkable, and living costs are generally lower than London/Bristol.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee. Lincoln explicitly scores GCSEs, UCAT sections and SJT, with contextual uplift possible.

name: University of Liverpool
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry plus Biology, Physics or Mathematics and a third academic subject; A*AB can also be accepted where the A*/A include the required sciences.
gcseReq: Strong GCSE profile is used as an academic screen; exact scoring/minimum rules should be checked on the current admissions page.
ucatPolicy: UCAT ranking; no guaranteed fixed cutoff
ucatDetail: For school-leaver applicants who meet academic criteria, the highest UCAT applicants are selected for interview. Graduate applicants use GAMSAT under separate rules.
contextualDetail: Applicants from specified disadvantaged/care backgrounds may receive flexibility in GCSE, UCAT or interview thresholds while core academic subject requirements remain. Exact benefit depends on the current contextual category.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated spiral curriculum using lectures, seminars, workshops, case-based learning, anatomy, simulation and clinical placements from Year 2 onward.
studentLife: Large, lively and comparatively affordable city with major music/nightlife/sport culture. It has a concentrated city-centre student environment and large NHS footprint.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere.

name: University of Manchester
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology/Human Biology or Chemistry plus one of Chemistry, Biology/Human Biology, Physics, Psychology, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
gcseReq: A strong GCSE profile is expected under the detailed admissions criteria, though the key post-eligibility discriminator is the annual UCAT threshold.
ucatDetail: Manchester uses a cohort-dependent UCAT threshold after academic screening; it cannot confirm the threshold before the UCAT deadline. Widening-participation applicants can be considered under a lower UCAT threshold.
contextualDetail: Contextual A-level offer AAB; UK refugee/care-experienced offer ABB. Recognised widening-participation programme completers can receive a lower UCAT threshold as well as a reduced offer.
teachingModel: Five-year active-learning curriculum. The defining feature is themed case discussion/TBL-style small-group learning supported by lectures, dissection, practical science, consultation-skills teaching and placements.
studentLife: Huge, diverse student city with extensive nightlife, culture, sport and research. Cost is lower than London but rising. Clinical years can become less city-centred depending on base allocation.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile. Manchester uses a cohort-dependent UCAT threshold after academic screening, so a previous cycle's number should never be shown as a guaranteed current cutoff.

name: University of Nottingham
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology/Human Biology and Chemistry.
gcseReq: Historically a strong GCSE profile is required, with multiple high grades and core Maths/English/science minimums. Current exact scoring should be checked because the curriculum/admissions landscape is changing.
ucatDetail: UCAT sections are scored rather than relying only on total; SJT contributes and Band 4 is rejected. Academic/GCSE scoring also matters.
contextualDetail: Contextual A100 offers are commonly around AAB; enhanced widening-participation/foundation routes can reduce requirements further for eligible applicants.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated spiral curriculum. A redesigned curriculum introduces early patient-centred case learning, reflective practice and more explicit clinical foundations before very placement-heavy Years 3–5.
studentLife: Large campus university next to a lively, relatively affordable city. Good transport and large hospitals; later years involve regional travel.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Oxford
aLevelReq: A*AA with at least A in Chemistry and at least one of Biology, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
gcseReq: No formal high GCSE minimum, but GCSE attainment is central to shortlisting: Oxford contextualises GCSE performance relative to school/background.
ucatDetail: A contextualised GCSE measure is combined 50:50 with UCAT normalised against Oxford applicants to generate a preliminary shortlist. Applicants without GCSEs receive double UCAT weight. Additional applicants are then manually/contextually reviewed.
selectionModel: 50% contextualised GCSE + 50% UCAT, then holistic review
contextualDetail: School performance, postcode/disadvantage and personal context influence the GCSE measure and further scrutiny. Applicants from the most disadvantaged backgrounds can be strongly recommended for interview if likely to meet the offer and perform suitably in UCAT. The standard Medicine offer is not routinely lowered.
teachingModel: Classic six-year 3+3 course: three preclinical/medical-sciences years followed by three clinical years. Oxford emphasises scientific depth, tutorials and laboratory/dissection work.
studentLife: A highly concentrated collegiate city with strong traditions, beautiful environment and very high academic expectations. Housing/costs are high and college life can dominate social identity.
strategicNote: There is no single metric that guarantees an interview. The school combines several elements, so applicants should assess the whole profile rather than chase one cutoff. Oxford is especially GCSE-sensitive because contextualised GCSE attainment and UCAT are both used in preliminary shortlisting.

name: University of Plymouth
aLevelReq: AAA including A in Biology and A in a second science from Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics or Psychology.
gcseReq: Seven GCSE passes around grade 4 including English, Mathematics and sciences under current detailed requirements; this is a comparatively accessible GCSE floor versus high-GCSE-scoring schools.
ucatDetail: UCAT is considered alongside Level 2/3 academic attainment; no single fixed total score describes selection. Graduate/non-standard applicants may use GAMSAT under separate rules.
contextualDetail: Eligible contextual applicants can receive around AAB on A100; the A102 foundation course has BBB requirements but is restricted by widening-participation eligibility.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated, case-based Peninsula curriculum with early clinical/professional development and progressively extensive placements.
studentLife: Strong coastal/outdoors identity with lower costs than Bristol/Brighton/London. Smaller urban environment but substantial student population.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Sheffield
aLevelReq: AAA including Chemistry or Biology and a second science, with science practical passes.
gcseReq: Five GCSEs at grade 7/A, with at least grade 6/B in Maths, English Language and sciences.
ucatDetail: 2027 hard minimum: 1800/2700. Applicants who meet academic requirements are then ranked by UCAT, and only the highest scorers receive interviews.
contextualDetail: Contextual offer AAB including A in Chemistry or Biology and a second science. Eligibility includes disadvantaged postcode, FSM, care/caring/estrangement/parenting/forced migration and recognised Sheffield/Realising Opportunities programmes.
teachingModel: Five-year phase-based course. Years 1–2 build systems science and clinical competencies with early patient/GP contact; Years 3–5 become increasingly clinical.
studentLife: Large but compact city with major green space/Peak District access, strong nightlife and lower living costs than the south. The university has a large, coherent student community.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere. Sheffield has a published 2027 floor of 1800/2700, but clearing 1800 does not itself make an applicant competitive because interview invitations are then ranked by UCAT.

name: University of Southampton
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology and one additional accepted science.
gcseReq: Seven GCSEs around grade 6 including English, Mathematics and sciences under current detailed requirements.
ucatPolicy: UCAT ranking; no guaranteed fixed cutoff
ucatDetail: Academically eligible applicants are ranked by total UCAT for interview; highest scores progress. No permanent fixed interview cutoff is promised.
contextualDetail: Contextual AAB offer for applicants meeting combinations of care, low participation/deprivation, outreach, FSM, estrangement or UCAT-bursary criteria.
teachingModel: Five-year integrated BM5 in four phases, with early clinical exposure and a well-defined shift into major placements from Year 3.
studentLife: Large coastal city with a major university campus and teaching hospital, good transport and a substantial student scene; less compact/characterful than Brighton/Bristol but generally cheaper.
strategicNote: Once the academic minimum is cleared, UCAT is the main pre-interview discriminator. Extra A-level strength above the published floor usually matters less than a stronger UCAT unless the school explicitly scores academics elsewhere. Southampton similarly ranks academically eligible school-leavers by total UCAT for interview.

name: University of St Andrews
location: St Andrews, Scotland then partner school
aLevelReq: Standard AAA; minimum AAB. Must include Chemistry and one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics.
gcseReq: Minimum five GCSEs at grade 7/A in one sitting for standard applicants, with some flexibility for those with achieved A levels; core Biology/Maths/English requirements apply if not taken higher.
ucatPolicy: UCAT ranking; no guaranteed fixed cutoff
ucatDetail: After academic screening, applicants are ranked by UCAT for interview.
contextualDetail: Typical WP offer one grade lower (AAB). Care-experienced applicants or those meeting SIMD20 plus low-progression-school criteria can qualify for guaranteed offers subject to minimums/interview/test. IMD20, estranged, care-experienced and refugee applicants receive a 10% global UCAT boost before interview selection.
teachingModel: First three years provide intensive scientific/preclinical medicine, anatomy/dissection, clinical skills and early patient exposure; students then transfer for three clinical years at an allocated partner school.
studentLife: Beautiful, highly collegiate small coastal town with traditions and strong community. Excellent for students who like a close-knit environment; poor fit for those who need metropolitan diversity/nightlife every day.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of St Andrews – ScotCOM
aLevelReq: Standard AAA; minimum AAB, including Chemistry and one of Biology, Mathematics or Physics.
gcseReq: Minimum five GCSEs at grade 7/A in one sitting for standard applicants, with stated exceptions for achieved A-level candidates; core Biology/Maths/English requirements apply.
ucatPolicy: UCAT required; no fixed 2027 cutoff published
ucatDetail: UCAT is used for ranking for interview after academic screening.
contextualDetail: Typical contextual offer AAB. Guaranteed-offer scheme for specified care/SIMD20 + low-progression-school applicants subject to minimums/interview/test; 10% UCAT boost for IMD20, estranged, care-experienced and refugee applicants.
teachingModel: Five-year Scottish Community Orientated Medicine programme. Early St Andrews science/clinical foundations lead into longitudinal/community-focused clinical education with a deliberate emphasis on primary care and regional workforce needs.
studentLife: Begins in the same small St Andrews environment but the clinical experience becomes more geographically distributed across Scotland.
strategicNote: This is not a pure-UCAT school. Academic history/GCSEs and UCAT both contribute to shortlisting, so a very strong UCAT may not fully compensate for a weaker scored academic profile.

name: University of Sunderland
aLevelReq: AAA including Biology or Chemistry plus another designated science (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Maths/Further Maths/Statistics) and a third academic subject.
gcseReq: Five GCSEs at grade 7/A, with at least grade 6/B in Maths, English, Biology, Chemistry and Physics under published rules.
ucatDetail: Applicants must be within the top eight deciles of the national cohort (i.e. not the bottom 20%). This is a minimum eligibility condition; applicants who pass then complete Sunderland's separate interview-selection tool.
selectionModel: UCAT percentile floor + separate selection tool
contextualDetail: Eligible contextual applicants can receive an AAB offer, but the normal UCAT/SJT condition still applies; context does not simply waive the admissions test.
teachingModel: Five-year spiral/PBL-influenced curriculum in three phases: Years 1–2 foundations with early clinical exposure; Years 3–4 pathology/complexity plus major placements; Year 5 preparation for professional practice.
studentLife: Relatively affordable North-East living with access to coast and Newcastle. The course is regionally embedded rather than centred on one huge tertiary-city campus.
strategicNote: Treat the published academic requirements as an eligibility floor, then follow the school's stated UCAT/academic ranking method. Do not assume a historical cutoff is a current guarantee.
